about: Server component (one instance): the inventory interaction requests after grouping. esv::inventory::GroupSystem::ProcessInventoryRequests (EoCServer.dll+0xFD6760) copies InteractionRequestsComponent into it field by field and regroups the member requests; StackSystem reads it. Seen once in an idle level, empty. Same layout and destructor as InteractionRequestsComponent.

evidence.says: bg3.exe creator 0x34D20E0 is identical to InteractionRequestsComponent's and shares its destructor bg3.exe+0x22CF8A0. GroupSystem::ProcessInventoryRequests copies +0 and +0x10 with EoCServer.dll+0xFD58B0 (IndexedStorage<ContainerInteractionRequestData>, alloc 0x10). Name from SE InteractionRequestSystem::ContainerInteractions.
Second ContainerInteractionRequestData array: same copy function EoCServer.dll+0xFD58B0 as +0. Role (e.g. deferred vs. immediate) not established.

GroupSystem::ProcessInventoryRequests iterates source+0x20 (the pointer read from source+0x20, count +0x2C, stride 0xE0) as MemberInteractionRequestData; destructor uses the 0xE0 variant-element clear.
Second MemberInteractionRequestData array: GroupSystem copies source+0x30 to target+0x30 element by element (AllocateInternal(n, 0xe0, 8), EoCServer.dll+0xF26A60). Role not established.
GroupSystem copies source+0x40 to target+0x40 with assert IndexedStorage<esv::inventory::NotifyInteractionRequestData>, stride 0x10. Name from SE InteractionRequestSystem::NotifyInteraction.

open_questions: Why there are two container and two member arrays (+0x10, +0x30).
The member variant (200 bytes) is left opaque.
survey.second_pass: Not settled: same open points as esv::inventory::InteractionRequestsComponent (identical creator and destructor in bg3.exe); roles of the arrays at +0x10/+0x30 not traced.
survey.status_reason: only empty (all-zero) instances were seen: the member boundaries are untested

fields.name: Inventory
fields.evidence: Element of IndexedStorage<esv::inventory::ContainerInteractionRequestData> (Toolkit asserts in EoCServer.dll+0xFD58B0 and StackSystem::ProcessInventoryRequests, allocation size 0x10). Same layout as SE ContainerInteractionRequestData (Inventory.h): EntityHandle Inventory + std::variant<ContainerSortData, ContainerScatterData>.

fields.name: ActionData0
fields.evidence: Variant storage byte 0: ContainerSortData::SortType or ContainerScatterData::ToParent (SE Inventory.h). InteractionRequestSystem::GatherRequests (EoCServer.dll+0xFC7B40) writes the dword at +8 as 0x0101xxxx when it queues a scatter request.

fields.name: ActionType
fields.evidence: std::variant index (0 = Sort, 1 = Scatter): GatherRequests stores 1 in byte +0xB for scatter requests.

fields.name: Inventory
fields.evidence: Element of IndexedStorage<esv::inventory::MemberInteractionRequestData> (Toolkit asserts in GroupSystem::ProcessInventoryRequests EoCServer.dll+0xFD6760; AllocateInternal(n, 0xe0, 8)). SE MemberInteractionRequestData: EntityHandle Inventory; int Amount; std::variant<MemberAddData, MemberMoveToSlotData, MemberTransferData, MemberDropData, MemberEquipmentRequestFailedData, MemberRemoveData> Action.

fields.name: Amount
fields.evidence: SE MemberInteractionRequestData::Amount; GroupSystem copies the dword at element+8 next to the handle at +0.

fields.name: ActionData
fields.evidence: std::variant storage, 200 bytes: bg3.exe+0x22E29E0 destroys element+0x10 with bg3.exe+0x22D5900 when the index byte (element+0x10+200) is 3 (MemberDropData, which holds an optional FixedString). Not decodable without a variant type.

fields.name: ActionType
fields.evidence: Variant index at element+0xD8 (checked against 3 by the element destructor; GroupSystem tests the byte at element+0xD8 for 0 for MemberAddData).

fields.name: Container
fields.evidence: IndexedStorage<esv::inventory::NotifyInteractionRequestData> (Toolkit assert), copied as 16 bytes, allocation 0x10. SE NotifyInteractionRequestData: EntityHandle Container, Actor.
